verdict_on_claim: Claim is mostly FALSE as stated for this segment. Gallabox already sells, with public INR self-serve pricing, a shared inbox across WhatsApp, Instagram DMs+comments, web widget and calls, AI agents that qualify leads against custom criteria written in instructions (docs: 'If they fit (5+ users, budget over $500/month)...'), 'scoring intent in real time', AI voice 'lead score before handoff', data-extraction webhooks, round-robin routing and a built-in Lead Pipeline (Advanced, ₹13,599/mo). Wati markets 'one inbox · every channel' with Astra agents that qualify and route leads (CRM via integrations). Interakt has a built-in WhatsApp Sales CRM with pipeline and a Lead Qualification AI agent. Gupshup's AI agent catalogue literally lists 'Qualifies and assigns leads based on budget, location and intent'. What is still genuinely open: (1) email as a first-class channel next to WhatsApp/IG/web/calls in an SMB product (only LimeChat's support CRM add-on and enterprise Yellow/Kapture cover email); (2) a transparent, business-configurable match score with priority-sorted queue across all channels as the core UX rather than an agent side-feature; (3) a real sales CRM natively unified with that inbox at SMB price - most rely on HubSpot/Zoho/LeadSquared integrations. FiguredOutAI should reposition from 'nobody does this' to 'the lead-prioritisation-first inbox (all channels incl. email) with a native CRM', and benchmark directly against Gallabox.
notes: Headless Chromium rejected the proxy CA; worked around by routing page requests through Playwright route.fetch (Node, TLS verified with NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS). Wati and Interakt pricing pages served USD to our (non-India) IP; INR figures for those two come from third-party blogs and are marked inferred. LimeChat, Gupshup, Yellow.ai, Kapture have no public SMB price lists. Funding numbers come from search-result summaries of Inc42/TechCrunch/Tracxn, not fetched articles. Did not verify inside products (no login/trial). Gupshup and Kapture channel details only partially verified.
